We finally did it! We made a distortion pedal. For Black Friday 2025 Mythos Pedals is releasing The Victor, a tribute to one of the most iconic hard clipping distortion pedals of all time. The Victor is a Through Hole type build using the best parts we could get. Wima Caps, OP07CP Chip, NOS Carbon Comp resistors populate the purple circuit board inside this new limited release. Sonically The Victor has an improved Filter and Distortion control, with a better range and taper. The overall amount of low end has been boosted slightly and the max distortion level has been brought down to make this pedal a touch more responsive and dynamic. The iconic sounds of that vermin-inspired gain box are here and built to the highest degree possible from the team at Mythos. The Victor features: Through Hole Construction with NOS components. True Bypass Switching Volume, Filter, Distortion Controls Quality Top Mount Panel Jacks Custom Bent Metal Enclosure Approx Enclosure size: 4.8" L x 3.7" W x 2.6" H Quick links Retired Models Search Former Dealers Contact Blog Plug In! Mythos Pedals browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal Mythos Pedals The Victor - Distortion Published on December 1, 2025 Mythos Pedals distortion pedal Information The Victor Distortion is a limited edition hard clipping distortion pedal created by Mythos Pedals as a tribute to one of the most iconic distortion circuits in pedal history. Released as a special Black Friday 2025 edition, The Victor is built using through-hole construction with premium components, including Wima capacitors, an OP07CP operational amplifier, and NOS carbon composition resistors. The pedal's design reflects Mythos' focus on high-quality craftsmanship and precision circuit replication while refining the control behavior and tonal balance for improved playability. The Victor delivers the classic aggressive distortion tones of the original inspiration, enhanced with increased low-end response and a smoother taper across its Filter and Distortion controls. These refinements provide a wider tonal range and a more dynamic, touch-sensitive response, making the pedal suitable for a broad range of rock and heavy styles. Built into a custom bent metal enclosure finished in purple and equipped with top-mounted jacks, The Victor combines vintage-inspired tone with modern construction reliability. Controls Volume: Sets the overall output level of the pedal. Filter: Adjusts the high-frequency response, shaping the tonal brightness or darkness. Distortion: Determines the amount of gain and saturation, with improved taper and dynamic response. Connections Input: Standard 1/4-inch instrument input jack (top-mounted). Output: Standard 1/4-inch output jack (top-mounted). Technical Specifications Bypass Type: True bypass switching. Circuit Type: Through-hole construction with Wima capacitors, OP07CP chip, and NOS carbon comp resistors. Power: Standard 9V DC operation (not specified if battery or adapter). Enclosure Dimensions: Approx. 4.8 in. (L) x 3.7 in. (W) x 2.6 in. (H). Highlights Tribute to a classic hard clipping distortion design. Improved Filter and Distortion controls for smoother response and wider range. Enhanced low-end presence and refined overall gain range. High-quality through-hole build with premium and NOS components. Custom bent metal enclosure with top-mounted jacks. L
